description: This file contains Swagger API resource definitions for the Centers API in the Fineract project. It defines various data transfer objects (DTOs) and responses related to centers, including templates, list responses, detailed center responses, and account details for centers.

classes.name: CentersApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Container for Swagger API classes related to Centers endpoints.

classes.name: GetCentersTemplateResponse
classes.description: Response DTO for retrieving centers template information, including office and staff options.

classes.name: GetCentersOfficeOptions
classes.description: Options for offices in centers template.

classes.name: GetCentersStaffOptions
classes.description: Options for staff in centers template.

classes.name: GetCentersResponse
classes.description: Response DTO for retrieving a list of centers.

classes.name: GetCentersPageItems
classes.description: Individual center item in centers list.

classes.name: GetCentersCenterIdResponse
classes.description: Detailed response for a specific center identified by ID.

classes.name: PostCentersRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for creating a new center.

classes.name: PostCentersResponse
classes.description: Response DTO after creating a new center.

classes.name: PutCentersCenterIdRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for updating an existing center.

classes.name: PutCentersCenterIdResponse
classes.description: Response DTO after updating a center.

classes.name: DeleteCentersCenterIdResponse
classes.description: Response DTO for deleting a center.

classes.name: PostCentersCenterIdRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for closing or performing actions on a center.

classes.name: PostCentersCenterIdResponse
classes.description: Response DTO after performing operations on a center.
